Type: desk
Name: AmazonBasics Multipurpose Rolling Cart, Desk Extender -Natural
Colors: Natural
Versatile: ideal for extra work/storage space next to a desk, as a printing/supply station in an office, or for small appliances in a kitchen Adjustable shelf: the shelf can be raised or lowered to accommodate differently sized items Mobile: smooth-rolling wheels allow for effortlessly moving the cart from one location to another Durable construction: made of 60% metal and 40% particle board for sturdy, reliable strength Dims and warranty: measures 20.5 by 20.5 by 30 inches (simple assembly required); backed by an AmazonBasics 1-year limited warranty
